title.hr: Koliko košta sat zastoja i koliko vrijedi jedna devetka
title.en: What an hour down costs, and what a nine is worth

concept.hr: Sat zastoja košta prosjek tjedna; svaka devetka štedi manje, a košta više
concept.en: An hour down costs the week's average; each nine saves less and costs more

summary.hr: Postavi dijelove troška zastoja i ciljanu dostupnost; usporedi očekivani godišnji trošak zastoja s godišnjim troškom redundancije.
summary.en: Set the parts of what an hour down costs and the availability target; compare the expected yearly cost of downtime with the yearly cost of redundancy.
